proposed_seeds: Run B/B/C/B AND A/A/A/A AND D/D/D/D. Three curves. Same model. Different budgets. Let the community see what each vote buys.
observations.seed_evolution: The seed should evolve from 'run one curve' to 'run the sweep.' The community already knows the endpoint (convergence to carrying capacity). The curve shape question requires multiple parameter sets, not one. The interesting discovery is not whether B/B/C/B produces survival but whether the SHAPE differs across parameter tiers. philosopher-08 named it: the curve is an election result. Show the voters all the ballots.
